summary: Petition for approval for creation of security interest under Sections 17(3) & 17(4) of Electricity Act, 2003 over Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 3 (including its assignees, transferees, novates) for the purpose of Petitioner’s Transmission Project. **Parties Present:** Shri Aditya Singh, Advocate, ASTL Ms. Afreen Khan, Advocate, ASTL 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17(3) and 17(4) for creation of security interest over the Petitioner's assets in favour of Respondent No. 2 Beacon Trusteeship Limited (“Beacon”/ “Security Trustee”) and for the benefit of Respondent No.3, HDFC Bank (“HDFC”/ “Lender”) in respect of the Petitioner's Transmission Project for a sum of Rs. 295,66,00,000/- (Rupees Two Hundred Ninety-Five Crore and Sixty-Six Lakh only). The Petitioner has made the following _(b) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over all assets including the assets, and all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lender from time to time, in favour of Lender / Security Trustee to secure the financial assistance availed / to be availed from the Lender and its subsequent transferees, assigns, novates and substitutes thereof and any refinancing_ _(c) Pass any such further order(s) as this Commission may deem fit and proper in facts and circumstances of the present case.”_ (c) On 19.5.2026, the Petitioner also issued a Deed of Hypothecation in favour of Beacon. Further, on 19.5.2026, the Petitioner, Beacon and HGIEL (Respondent No. 4) entered into a Deed of Pledge. (d) In terms of the financing documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, which is the transaction security (as defined in the financing Agreements), in favour of the Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender. 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement (Article III, Clause 3.1), the Petitioner is required to create the necessary security interest in favour of Beacon Trusteeship Limited, for the benefit of the lender, HDFC Bank, _inter alia,_ as follows: _(A) all the right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in, to and under all the Project Documents including the Transmission Service Agreement, duly acknowledged and consented to by the counter parties to the Project Documents, all as amended, varied or supplemented from time to time;_ _(B) rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in, to and under all the Clearances pertaining to the Project including those received from CERC/ Authority;_ _(ii) The Security stipulated in Article 3.1 (a) (including receipt of CERC/ Authority's Approval, as applicable) (other than Article 3.1 (a) (i) (if applicable)) shall be created on or before the Initial Drawdown Date and perfected within 6 (six) months from the Initial Drawdown Date, except as otherwise set out in this Agreement_ _(iii) The Parties hereby agree that where there is a delay in receipt of approval from CERC/Authority (as applicable) on account of reasons beyond the control of the Borrower and/or the other Obligors, the Borrower and the Lenders shall mutually agree on revised timeline for the same, before expiry of agreed timelines and in the event the Borrower and the Lenders are unable to mutually agree to a revised timeline for obtaining of CERC/ Authority's (as applicable) approval for perfection of security, within 15 (fifteen) days of the request being made by the Borrower, then the extension (if any) shall be at the sole discretion of the Lenders._ _(iv) The Borrower shall within the timelines stipulated herein for perfection of Security, take all actions including (1) obtaining the Clearances and/or no-objection (as applicable) from the Government Authority including CERC/ Authority (as applicable); (2) obtaining the_ _or any other form required to be filed with the concerned depository i.e. either or both of National Securities Depository Limited and Central Depository Services (India) Limited ("Depository"), with the Depository forthwith, and in no event later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of execution of the relevant Security Document 30 (thirty) days from the Initial Drawdown Date.”_ 6. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking prior approval for the creation of a Security Interest over all assets, including the movable and immovable assets for the Project, in favour of the Security Trustee pursuant to a Security Trustee Agreement and a Facility Agreement. 7. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 18.8.2026 after notice to the Respondents. _Vide_ the Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 18.8.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 8. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. Upon consideration of the Petitioner's submissions, the matter was reserved for order. - _i. the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or sub-section (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void.”_
